title: feat(app-shell,types,i18n,cli): cloud:workspace-timezone-notice names the seeded workspace timezone on the welcome page (objectui#11930)
body:
Fixes #11930
Clause-②: yes

The objectui half of objectstack-ai/cloud#2676 step 3. A registered SDUI widget, `cloud:workspace-timezone-notice`, prints one line on the Cloud welcome page naming the timezone a workspace was seeded with at creation. It reads the additive `workspaceTimezoneSeed` from the org-scoped `GET /api/v1/cloud/environment-entitlements` summary, the one `cloud:plan-status` and the environment list already read. It renders nothing when that field is absent.

**File surface.** The claim (`6057491447`) was amended by the seat in `6058827980` (option A), after the dev's stop report `6058785780`. The amendment adds `packages/app-shell/package.json` (`sideEffects` only), `packages/app-shell/src/environment/entitlements.ts`, the `@object-ui/types` arm files and their tests, and one row of the CLI ratchet. It also adds `@object-ui/types` (minor) to the `Clause-②` widening. Precedent: `24d3e656` (objectui#10990, `cloud:plan-status`) touched the same file set.

## Every widening, checkable from this body

Spelling note: the platform sanitizer eats angle-bracket fragments, so generics are written in words below ("`Record` of `string` to `never`").

### 1. Language-pack key — `@object-ui/i18n` (minor)

One new key, `cloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.seeded`, in all ten packs (`ar de en es fr ja ko pt ru zh`). Each pack has one interpolation, the i18next placeholder named `zone`, which is written as ZONE below. No other key was added, changed or removed.

| pack | value (ZONE = the placeholder `zone`) |
| --- | --- |
| en | The workspace timezone was set to ZONE from your browser when the workspace was created. You can change it in Settings → Localization. |
| zh | 工作区时区在创建时已按你的浏览器设为 ZONE，可在「设置 → 本地化」中修改。 (the cloud seat's suggested copy, plus a full stop) |
| ja | ワークスペースのタイムゾーンは、作成時にブラウザーに合わせて ZONE に設定されました。「設定 → ローカリゼーション」で変更できます。 |
| ko | 워크스페이스 시간대는 생성 시 브라우저에 맞춰 ZONE(으)로 설정되었습니다. 설정 → 현지화에서 변경할 수 있습니다. |
| de | Die Zeitzone des Workspace wurde beim Erstellen anhand Ihres Browsers auf ZONE festgelegt. Sie können sie unter Einstellungen → Lokalisierung ändern. |
| es | La zona horaria del espacio de trabajo se configuró en ZONE a partir de su navegador al crearlo. Puede cambiarla en Configuración → Localización. |
| fr | Le fuseau horaire de l’espace de travail a été défini sur ZONE d’après votre navigateur lors de sa création. Vous pouvez le modifier dans Paramètres → Localisation. |
| pt | O fuso horário do workspace foi definido como ZONE com base no seu navegador quando ele foi criado. Você pode alterá-lo em Configurações → Localização. |
| ru | Часовой пояс рабочего пространства был задан по вашему браузеру при его создании: ZONE. Его можно изменить в разделе «Настройки → Локализация». |
| ar | تم تعيين المنطقة الزمنية لمساحة العمل إلى ZONE وفقًا لمتصفحك عند إنشائها. يمكنك تغييرها من الإعدادات → التوطين. |

The zone is printed verbatim: it is an IANA id, and no `Intl` call formats it. Each pack reuses its own existing vocabulary for "workspace timezone", taken from its `workspaceTimezonePrompt` block, and its own word for "Settings". "Settings → Localization" is the Setup nav entry `nav_settings_localization` (objectstack `platform-objects`).

### 2. Newly accepted type — `@object-ui/cli` (minor) and the validator

- `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` (`packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`, GENERATED) gains exactly one row, `'cloud:workspace-timezone-notice'`, so `objectui check` accepts it. It was regenerated with `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`, and `--check` reports OK. There is no bare `workspace-timezone-notice` row and no `app-shell:`-prefixed twin, because the registration is `{ namespace: 'cloud', skipFallback: true }`, the same as `cloud:plan-status`.
- `objectui validate` / `safeValidateSchema`: `AnyComponentSchema` now claims the literal (section 4). The CLI ratchet `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859` keeps `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` at 360 and gains the row "counts `cloud:workspace-timezone-notice` armed — it registered WITH its arm (objectui#11930)".

### 3. New `@object-ui/types` exports (minor), with their shapes

- **`@object-ui/types/zod`** (`zod/index.zod.ts` re-exports from `zod/cloud.zod.ts`): `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeSchema`

  ```ts
  BaseSchema.extend({
    type: z.literal('cloud:workspace-timezone-notice'),
    properties: z.strictObject({}).optional(),   // the widget reads no prop: the only bag accepted is {}
    body: retirementTombstone(CLOUD_WORKSPACE_TIMEZONE_NOTICE_NEITHER_CHANNEL),
    children: retirementTombstone(CLOUD_WORKSPACE_TIMEZONE_NOTICE_NEITHER_CHANNEL),
  })
  ```

  The members are the keys the widget reads, and no others. `@objectstack/spec` has no `ComponentPropsMap` row for a `cloud:` widget, so nothing is read by reference. The closed empty bag is the spelling `element:divider` uses for a node with no prop. Both content channels are refused by name, and the refusal text carries the family-D parser-tier clause that `content-channel-parser-tier-clause-10928` pins.
- **`@object-ui/types`** (root, re-exported from `cloud.ts`): the TS twin, interface `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeSchema extends BaseSchema` with members `type: 'cloud:workspace-timezone-notice'`, `properties?` typed `Record` of `string` to `never`, `body?: never` and `children?: never`. Its parity pair `cloud.zod.ts#CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeSchema` is registered in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, where `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` goes from 194 to 195.

### 4. Union members

- `AnyComponentSchema` (zod) gains one member, `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeSchema`, after `CloudPlanStatusSchema`. Its accept set widens by exactly that literal. `StrictAnyComponentSchema` is derived from it, so it follows with no edit. `any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts` lists the member as an inline arm, and the declaration-size headroom test stays green.
- `AnySchema` (TS) gains one member, `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeSchema`, after `CloudPlanStatusSchema`.
- Nothing that parsed before is refused now.

### 5. The changeset — `.changeset/11930-workspace-timezone-notice.md`

Four `minor` entries and nothing else: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/cli`. There is no `major` (`check-changeset-no-major` OK).

### 6. `@object-ui/app-shell` (minor)

- It registers the widget, `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice`, from `console/home/CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.tsx`. The entry `src/index.ts` gains one side-effect import beside the `CloudPlanStatus.js` import.
- `sideEffects` (a published contract field) gains `./dist/console/home/CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.js` and `./src/console/home/CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.tsx`. Nothing else in `package.json` moved. `check:side-effects-array` reports that the array "names exactly the 16 module(s) that register at load time".
- **Built-entry declarations, measured:** `dist/index.d.ts` keeps the new side-effect import, so the widget's `.d.ts` (`CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNoticeProps` with `className?: string`, and the component function) is in the declaration closure. `exports` has only `.`, so no new name is importable. A walk of the `.d.ts` import graph from `dist/index.d.ts` reaches 175 files and not `environment/entitlements.d.ts`. So the hook's widened result type is package-internal.
- `EnvironmentEntitlementsSummary` and `EnvironmentEntitlementsState` (`environment/entitlements.ts`) each gain `workspaceTimezoneSeed?: string`. The hook reads it verbatim, as it reads `upgradeUrl`. The row-derived and unknown fallback states never carry it.

## Behaviour

- Seed present: one `p` element, `text-sm text-muted-foreground`, with `data-workspace-timezone-notice="seeded"`. The node's `className` / `responsiveStyles` scope class reaches it. It is text only: no link (cloud#2676 Q2) and no dismissal state.
- It renders nothing when the summary has no seed or an empty one, while loading, when the request fails (non-OK), when the request rejects, and when the body is not the `{ success, data }` envelope (cloud#1046). It never throws: the hook swallows the failure and falls back to the rows, which carry no seed.

## Verification

All of these ran from the worktree root. Heavy runs went through the shared `os-verify-lock`.

- **After merging `main` 70e3d772 (merge commit 113443d4, no conflict; `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` auto-merged):**
  - the widget pin, the arm pin, `zod-mirror-parity`, `any-component-emit-headroom-11573` and the CLI ratchet: 5 files, 94 tests passed;
  - `regenerate-known-schema-types --check`: OK;
  - `check:side-effects-array`: OK;
  - `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/cli`: all exit 0, after building their dependency closures.
- **On 4929b50d, before the merge:**
  - `packages/types/`: 360 files, 9615 tests;
  - `packages/i18n/`: 82 files, 1316 passed and 13 skipped;
  - `packages/cli/`: 25 files, 370 tests;
  - `packages/app-shell/`, NARROWED: 27 files, 209 tests. The full package is 1166 files and belongs to CI. The 27 are `console/home/__tests__/`, `environment/__tests__/` and every test that reads the hook, the summary endpoint, `cloud:`, `sideEffects` or the barrel;
  - 13 root `scripts/__tests__` files that read the touched files: 811 tests.
- **Gates on 4929b50d:** these were all green: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only), `check:readme-exports`, `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:sdui-registration-pins` (`workspace-timezone-notice` is present in 1 chunk) and `check-changeset-presence`. eslint on the 24 touched `.ts/.tsx` files gave 0 errors. The config is not type-aware, and repo-wide lint is CI's.
- **Reverse checks** used `ablation-replace` in wrap mode, with a trap and absolute paths. Every subject resolves to `src`, through relative imports and the vitest alias for `@object-ui/types/zod`, so no `dist` is involved. Each mutation was restored to the HEAD blob, and the tool proved the restore.
  - A, the widget ignores the seed: 5 of the widget file's 12 tests go red, exactly the seed-present pins (EN, ZH, endpoint, one line, SchemaRenderer). The absent, empty, loading, failed, rejected and bare-body controls stay green.
  - B, the hook drops the field: the same 5 go red.
  - C, the arm leaves the union: 12 go red, including the ratchet's "`objectui validate` refuses 361 registered namespaced key(s) at `type`; the pin is 360".
- **First-load bytes:** this was measured locally before the merge, from console builds of both sides on one box. `eagerGzipBytes` is +195 B (+752 raw): `i18n-locale-en` +63 gz and `src` +153 gz, and every other chunk is raw-identical. That put 4929b50d at 3307.6 KB against the then-ceiling of 3307.0 KB, with base f3a0488c at 3307.4 KB. `main` now carries the rollback (3c888c6e) and the 5,120 B allowance (1c51e973). The authoritative reading is this PR's `Bundle Analysis` run, and the report on the card quotes it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Localization label.** objectstack `platform-objects` translates the Setup nav label `nav_settings_localization` only for en, zh-CN, es-ES and ja-JP. A de, fr, pt, ko, ru or ar user therefore sees the English "Localization" in the Setup nav, while this notice names the translated word (Lokalisierung, Localisation, Localização, 현지화, Локализация, التوطين). This is an observation, not filed: no public door gives a wrong answer, and nobody has picked it up.
- The widget takes `className` only. The dispatch's suggested props were `{ properties, className }`, but the widget reads no prop, and the arm declares the bag empty.
- Out of scope, as the card says: the cloud field (cloud#2676 step 2), the welcome-page node (step 4) and the creation half (objectui#11908).
